newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines eyes guarantee fund for BOT projects.
newsitem.headline: Philippines eyes guarantee fund for BOT projects.

text.p: The Philippines is considering charging guarantee fees from proponents of Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) projects to create a sinking fund to cover against defaults, a paper prepared by the finance department released on Thursday showed.

The paper, due to be presented to the Asia-Pacific Economoic Cooperation (APEC) forum ministerial meeting in central Cebu province at the weekend, is the report of the Philippines on its efforts to enhance private sector participation in infrastructure development.
BOT projects are infrastructure to be built and managed by private companies for a certain period before handing them over to the government.
Under the proposal, project builders will be able to draw from the proposed guarantee feed if the government is unable to pay for the project, officials said.
They said the fund would give private sectors more confidence in investing in capital intensive projects.
Details of the fund were not immediately available.
